rules.msg: Portuguese Civil Code is No — Schedule 5A must not be filed.
Allowances exempt u/s 10 (3) must equal the sum of the drop-down rows.
Entertainment allowance 16(ii) is not allowed for employees other than Central/State Government and PSU.
Exempt allowance u/s 10(13A) must match the eligible exemption in the 10(13A) table.
HRA u/s 10(13A) cannot exceed actual rent paid less 10% of salary+DA.
HRA exemption must be the lowest of actual HRA, rent paid less 10%, and 40%/50% of salary+DA.
Property 1: interest payable on borrowed capital must equal the 24(b) table total.
HP item 2 must equal the house-property pass-through in Schedule PTI.
Total STCG must equal the individual short-term heads.
CG B4a must equal column 14 of Schedule 112A.
OS 57(iia) is the lower of one-third of family pension and Rs.15,000 (old regime).
CYLA HP income must equal item 3 of Schedule HP.
CYLA salary income must equal item 6 of Schedule S.
A PRAN must be provided to claim 80CCD(1) or 80CCD(1B).
Schedule EI: item 5 must equal the exempt pass-through income in Schedule PTI.
Part B-TI: salary income must equal Schedule S.
Part B-TI: 12a must equal Part B plus Part CA & D of Schedule VI-A.
Deduction u/s 80JJAA is claimed — Form 10DA is required.
Deduction u/s 10AA is claimed — Form 56F should be filed.
